name: East Buildtech Limited
about: East Buildtech Limited engages in the real estate business in India. The company acquires land; and erects and constructs houses, flats, shops, offices, stores, apartments, and buildings. It is also involved in infrastructure development. The company was formerly known as Chokhani Business Limited and changed its name to East Buildtech Limited. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.
